groups.problem: Error IDs are paired positionally with nodestore mapping values, which can associate IDs with the wrong event data.
groups.rationale: All three identify the same positional zip and recommend lookup by node ID. Reordering, deduplication, and missing results are different triggers for the same identity-pairing problem.

groups.problem: The age/timestamp mutual-exclusion validators use truthiness instead of field presence, allowing zero values to bypass checks.
groups.rationale: Both report the same guards in the same validators and propose explicit key-presence checks.

groups.problem: The feature-flagged table visualization receives hardcoded empty columns and data instead of actual query results.
groups.rationale: Both identify the same placeholder props as the cause of empty dashboard tables when the feature flag is enabled.
